title: Ladder: Counting to Calculus
description: The full climb from tally marks to calculus: counting → addition/subtraction → multiplication/division → fractions → negatives → algebra (unknowns) → functions → limits → derivatives → integrals. Each rung uses the last: algebra is arithmetic with unknowns, calculus is algebra with infinity. The ladder's moral: no step is skipped — 'I was never good at math' usually means a missed rung, not a missing gift.
